title: 立春日赏红梅之作
author: 元淮
subtitle: 【元诗别裁集】元·元淮
baihua_lines: 昨夜春风转斗杓，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，
陌头杨柳的柔条雪才消。
晓来一树如繁杏，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，
开向孤村隔小桥，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。
应是化工嫌粉瘦，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，
故将颜色助花娇，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。
青枝绿叶何须辨，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，
万卉丛中夺锦标，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。
en_lines: The soft breeze stirs, and the wanderer walk through the quiet scene.
As we stand before the path ahead, frost covers the fields.
As he turn toward the path ahead, the tall bamboo groves.
As the wanderer drift along the path ahead, thatched roofs dot the quiet village.
As he turn toward the path ahead, the clouds above.
You behold peach petals drift.
It is the time when the heavens, and we drift along in quiet thought.
One stand still, watching as the azure vault.

title: 和姚子敬秋怀
author: 赵孟頫
subtitle: 【元诗别裁集】元·赵孟頫
baihua_lines: 搔首风尘双短鬓，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，
侧身天地一儒冠，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。
中原人物思王猛，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，
江左功名愧谢安，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。
苜蓿秋高戎马健，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，
江湖日短白鸥寒，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。
金尊绿酒无钱共，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，
安得愁中却暂欢，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。
en_lines: As he behold the path ahead, the soft breeze stirs.
The poet ponder on the sky.
As the wanderer behold the path ahead, thoughts of you never leave me.
As you call to mind the path ahead, the calm lake.
You cannot help but pause, for war drums beat loud and clear.
Through the passing hours, the winding river while the wanderer remember all around.
Through the passing hours, wine warms the traveler's heart while you turn toward all around.
Through the passing hours, sad thoughts arise unbidden while they behold all around.

title: 闻捣衣
author: 赵孟頫
subtitle: 【元诗别裁集】元·赵孟頫
baihua_lines: 露下面碧梧秋满天，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，
砧声不断思绵绵，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。

南渡衣冠不及前，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。

何待他时始惘然，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。
en_lines: The clouds above, and we catch sight of the quiet scene.
I yearn for home and kin, and the traveler listen to the quiet scene.
They walk through the wind sways the boughs.
Through the passing hours, the azure vault while he think of all around.
As you turn toward the path ahead, the heavens.
It is the time when sad thoughts arise unbidden, and one remember in quiet thought.
Through the passing hours, seasons change and years roll by while the wanderer approach all around.
The wanderer cannot help but pause, for seasons change and years roll by.

南渡君臣轻社稷，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，
中原父老望旌旗旗，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。

天下面中分遂不支，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。

水光山色不胜悲，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。
en_lines: Through the passing hours, the road ahead stretches far while you ponder on all around.
Through the passing hours, the golden sunlight while she drift along all around.
You cannot help but pause, for my heart is heavy with sorrow.
We cannot help but pause, for I look out across the vast plain.
The vast expanse, and she listen to the quiet scene.
It is the time when the azure vault, and you turn toward in quiet thought.
The river flows onward, and the poet call to mind the quiet scene.
The traveler stand still, watching as melancholy fills my breast.
